description: The open plains spread across a sunlit frontier valley beneath distant red mesas. A dusty track winds from the lower-right foreground through yellow grass and scrub, while a small blue pond fills a rocky hollow on the left. Low fences, timber structures and scattered barrels mark a modest working patch farther back. Boulders, cactus-like plants and sparse trees break up the open ground. Beyond them, broad flat-topped ridges stand against a blue sky with pale clouds. The path, pond and distant mesas give the plain depth without enclosing it; much of the scene is open grass and earth.
